about_the_game:
IT'S 1963 - THREE YEARS AFTER THE WAR

Three years after the missiles stopped.  But that didn't stop the Robotic Regime. They have nuked the entirety of Earth's surface. Now, the last remaining humans live crammed like sardines in underwater colonies known as H20ME's.  But there is hope.  An unlikely pair of seasoned Vets has been recruited for a top secret mission: Rusted Sea.  

UNLIKELY HEROES

As Finn Fontane and Cade Callahan, you will fight your wave through swarms menacing Regime Botfish, leverage the unique abilities of other sea creatures to overcome obstacles, and most importantly, work together against all odds to complete the mission.  

ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY

Armed with an arsenal of state-of-the-art weapons and gadgets, including the fierce Sea Minor mini-sub - there is no reason to think that you will be completely overpowered by endless waves of merciless SeaBots that stand in your way.  

EXOTIC SEALIFE

Encounter a variety of sea creatures, some with special mutations from residual wartime radiation.  Win them over with your FinnFluence and use their abilities to accomplish critical mission objectives. 

FIREPOWER FODDER

Unleash your righteous indignation as you exact revenge on the hordes of SeaBots that seemingly spawn out of nowhere.  Sure their razor sharp teeth can decimate you in a matter of seconds, but that's only if they get close enough.

short_description: Earth's surface has been entirely irradiated by nuclear fallout from The War and Regime Robots have taken control. A small colony of humans fight for their lives underwater. The survival of our species rests on an unlikely pair of Vets who have been recruited for one last mission: Rusted Sea.
